strings.privacy.title: Ubumfihlo
strings.privacy.description: Indlela i-pdffusion ephatha ngayo amafayili akho: akukho akhawunti, akukho dokhumenti egciniweyo, akukho zikhangiso futhi akukho ukuthengiswa kwemininingwane.
strings.privacy.intro: I-pdffusion yakhelwe ukuthi amadokhumenti akho ahlale angawakho. Nanka amazwi acacileyo ngalokho okwenzekayo nxa uyisebenzisa.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Amafayili akho
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Athunyelwa ngokufihliweyo (HTTPS), aphathwa ngokuzenzakalelayo, bese asulwa mhlana kuphela umphumela. Amafayili amakhulu adlula endaweni yesikhashana ngaphansi kwegama elingahleliweyo futhi asulwa mhlana umsebenzi uphetha; ukuhlanzwa okuzenzakalelayo kususa konke okungase kusale kungakapheli amahora angama-24.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Akukho akhawunti, akukho mininingwane yomuntu
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: I-pdffusion ayiceli ukubhalisa, akukho ikheli le-imeyili futhi akukho khadi lezikweletu. Amadokhumenti akho awakaze afundwe, ahlaziywe, abelwe noma asetshenziselwe ukuqeqesha ubuchopho bokwenziwa.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Ukulinganiswa kwezivakashi
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Sibala izivakashi ngaphandle kokwaziwa nangaphandle kwamakhukhi (Vercel Web Analytics) ukuze sifunde ukuthi yimaphi amathuluzi awusizo. Akukho zikhangiso, akukho ukulandelela okuvela kwenye indawo.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Amakhukhi
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Ikhukhi elilodwa, elikhethekayo: likhumbula ulimi olukhethileyo.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Ukusingathwa
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Isayithi lisingathwa yiVercel kumaseva aseParis; ukuguqulwa kwe-Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint kuphathwa yiRender eFrankfurt. Laba abahlinzeki baphethe amafayili ngesikhathi sokuguqulwa kuphela.

strings.legal.terms.sections[1].text: i-pdffusion imahhala, ngaphandle kokubhalisa nangaphandle komkhawulo wesikhathi, kumuntu wonke: abantu ngabanye, abafundi, othisha, amabhizinisi, imibutho engenzi nzuzo, abaphathi bakahulumeni nohulumeni, eCanada nakwamanye amazwe onke. strings.legal.terms.sections[2].text: Ungasebenza nganoma yiluphi uhlobo lwedokhumenti, kubandakanya ezemfihlo, ngoba i-pdffusion ayifundi, ayihlaziyi, ayigcini noma ayihlanganyeli amafayili akho: asetshenziswa ngokuzenzakalelayo bese asuswa. Uhlala ungumnikazi wawo, futhi ungaphezu kwalokho unamathuba adingekayo wokusebenza nawo.

strings.legal.terms.sections[3].text: Ikhodi yomthombo ye-pdffusion ikhishwa ngaphansi kwelayisensi ye-MIT. Ungayifunda, uyicubungule, uyifake kumaseva akho (kubandakanya kunethiwekhi evaliwe engenayo i-Internet), uyiguquule futhi uyihambise mahhala, uma nje ugcina isaziso sokulungelo lokushicilela kanye nombhalo welayisensi.

strings.legal.terms.sections[4].text: Awukwazi ukusebenzisa i-pdffusion emisebenzini engekho emthethweni, uzame ukuphazamisa inkonzo (ukulayisha ngobuningi okuzenzakalelayo, imizamo yokungena) noma ukweqa imikhawulo yobuchwepheshe. strings.legal.security.description: Kwenzakalani ngamafayili akho ku-pdffusion: ukusebenza okuzenzakalelayo, ukungahlaziywa, ukususwa kwamanje, ukubethela, ukusingathwa baseYurophu, kanye nokukhetha ukuyifaka kumaseva akho.

strings.legal.security.sections[0].title: Awekho amadokhumenti agciniweyo
strings.legal.security.sections[0].text: Amafayili akho acutshungulwa ngokuzenzakalelayo, bese asuswa lapho umphumela usulungele noma usulandiwe. Akukho khophi, akukho sisekelo sokugcina futhi akukho mlando. Ukuhlanza okuvame ukwenzeka nsuku zonke kususa noma yiliphi fayili lesikhashana elingase lisele, ngosuku olulandelayo kungakapheli isikhathi.
strings.legal.security.sections[1].title: Akukho ukuhlaziywa
strings.legal.security.sections[1].text: Akukho muntu ocinga imibhalo yakho. Kayifakwanga ohlwini, kayihlaziywanga, kayihlanganyelwanga noma isetshenziswe ukuqeqesha ubuchwepheshe bokuhlakanipha kokufakelwa. i-pdffusion ayinawo ama-akhawunti, akukho zikhangiso futhi awekho amaphrofayili abasebenzisi.
strings.legal.security.sections[2].title: Ukubethela
strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: Konke ukuxhumana kubetheliwe (HTTPS) futhi isiza siphokophelela ukubethela kukho konke ukuvakasha (HSTS). Ithuluzi lokuvikela libethela ama-PDF akho nge-AES-256; ipasiwedi oyikhethayo ayilondolozwa nakancane.
strings.legal.security.sections[3].title: Lapho amafayili akho acutshungulwa khona
strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Isiza, ama-PDF namathuluzi wezithombe: Vercel, isikhungo sedatha saseParis (France, European Union). Ukuguqula i-Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint: Render, eFrankfurt (Germany, European Union). Amafayili angaphezu kuka-4 MB: indawo yokugcina yesikhashana ye-Vercel Blob, ngaphansi kwegama elingaziwa, elisuswe ngemuva kokusetshenziswa.
strings.legal.security.sections[4].title: Ukuphepha kobuchwepheshe
strings.legal.security.sections[4].text: Amakhanda okuphepha (HSTS, ukuvimba isiza ukuthi singafakwa kwamanye amakhasi, ukuvikelwa ekudidekeni kohlobo lwefayili), amakheli amafayili esikhashana angenakugqekezwa, kanye nenkonzo yokuguqula eyamukela kuphela izicelo ezinephawu oluyimfihlo. Lonke ushintsho lwekhodi luhlola ngokuzenzakalelayo (izivivinyo, ukuhlola izinhlobo) ngaphambi kokuqala ukuvela ngqo.
strings.legal.security.sections[5].title: Ubumfihlo nomthetho osebenzayo
strings.legal.security.sections[5].text: i-pdffusion ishicilelwe eNew Brunswick futhi ihambisana nomthetho wokuvikelwa kwemininingwane yomuntu siqu kanye namadokhumenti kagesi waseCanada (PIPEDA). Ayibutheleli mininingwane yomuntu siqu ngabasebenzisi bayo: akukho akhawunti, akukho ikheli le-imeyili, akukho khukhi yokulandela. Yakhiwe phezu kwemigomo efanayo ne-GDPR yaseYurophu kanye Nomthetho 25 waseQuebec: ukunciphisa idatha, ukungaphinde kusetshenziswe, ukususwa ngemuva kokucutshungulwa.
strings.legal.security.sections[6].title: Kunezinhlangano ezinemithetho eqinile
strings.legal.security.sections[6].text: Uma imithetho yakho ivimba ukuthumela amadokhumenti enkonzweni yangaphandle, faka i-pdffusion kumaseva akho. Isoftware ephelele imahhala, ingumthombo ovulekile futhi isebenza ngaphandle kokuxhumeka kwe-Internet: akukho fayili elike lishiye inethiwekhi yakho. Umhlahlandlela wokufaka usekhasini lephrojekthi.

strings.legal.security.sections[7].text: Ikhowudi yomthombo epheleleyo ivulelekile: amaqembu akho okuphepha angabuyekeza ngalinye lala mazwi.

strings.legal.accessibility.title: Ukufinyeleleka
strings.legal.accessibility.description: Isitatimende sokufinyeleleka se-pdffusion: izinga le-WCAG 2.2 level AA, izinyathelo ezikhona, imikhawulo eyaziwayo nokuthi ungabika njani isithiyo.
strings.legal.accessibility.intro: Umuntu wonke kumele akwazi ukusebenzisa i-pdffusion, kubandakanya abantu abangaboniyo noma abanokubona okuncane, abangezwa noma abanenkinga yokuzwa, noma abanenkinga yomzimba noma yengqondo.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].title: Izinga elihlosiwe
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: i-pdffusion ihlose ukulandela imihlahlandlela yokufinyeleleka kwemicu yewebhu (WCAG) 2.2, izinga le-AA, umthetho wamazwe ngamazwe we-W3C. strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].title: Isimo sokuhambisana
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: i-pdffusion iyahambisana ngokwengxenye ne-WCAG 2.2 level AA: imikhawulo eyaziwayo ibaliwe ngezansi. Lesi sitatimende sisekelwe ekuhloleni kwangaphakathi okwenziwe ngo-October 2, 2026, kusetshenziswa amathuluzi azenzakalelayo (axe, Lighthouse) nokuhlola ngesandla (ikhibhodi, ukwehlukana kwemibala, ukusondeza, izimemezelo). Alikho i-audit ezimele eyenziwe okwamanje.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: Okukhona
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Indawo iphelele isebenza ngekhibhodi, enesixhumanisi esithi “Tshiya uye kokuqukethwe” kanye nomgca obonakalayo entweni esebenzayo. Ukuhlukana kwemibala yombhalo kuyi-4.5:1 okungenani. Amanyathelo omsebenzi (ukulayisha, umphumela, iphutha) aziswa kwabafundi besikrini. Ukulandelana kwefayili kungatshintshwa ngaphandle kokutsala nokulahla, kusetshenziswa amaqhosha. Indawo ilandela isilungiselelo sedivayisi sakho “sokunciphisa ukunyakaza”: izithombe ezinyakazayo bese zima ngokuphelele. Amakhasi ahlala efundeka kusondezo se-400% nasemakhenini weselula. Ulimi lweliphi naliphi ikhasi liyamenyezwa, kanti isi-Arabhu siboniswa kusuka ngokunene kuye ngobunxele.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].title: Imikhawulo eyaziwayo
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].text: Ngaphandle kwaleso silungiselelo, izithombe ezihlobisayo (ingemuva, indandatho, umbhalo ohambayo womumo) ziyaqhubeka ukusebenza; umbhalo ohambayo uyama uma uwubamba ngegundwane noma ngokugxile kwikhibhodi. Indandatho enyakazayo ekhasini lasekhaya isetshenziswa ngegundwane noma ngomunwe; iyinto yokuhlobisa, kanti uhlu lwemumo olubonisayo lutholakala njengombhalo ekhasini. Izilimi ezihunyushwe ngomshini zingaba namaphutha. Okokugcina, ukufikeleleka kwedokhumenti eyenziwe kuxhomeke koyokuqala: i-pdffusion ayifaki amathegi okufikeleleka ku-PDF engenayo.

strings.tools.ocr.seoDescription: Funda umbhalo we-PDF eskeniwe noma isithombe (OCR) ukuze ukwazi ukuwusesha, ukuwakopisha noma ukuwufundela phezulu. Izilimi ezingu-16, mahhala, umqulu awulayishwa.
strings.tools.ocr.intro: Umqulu othiwe iskeni noma owenziwe isithombe uyisithombe nje: awukwazi ukusesha igama noma ukukopisha umusho.
